svg.title: Four-bend cable trough for a test-station frame
svg.desc: Original synthetic folded sheet-metal concept. Dimensions and bend intent are customer requirements, not a developed flat pattern or supplier-approved design.

g.text: Bottom slots: 6.5 wide x 15 long, axes X; see mounting-holes.csv
Proposed 1.5 steel / R2 inside bends. Check actual stock and press capability.
Returns point outward. Interior service clearance below returns: at least 45.
